dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: Hey! Friend! Pal! Buddy! Listen to this inside scoop. Snezhnaya's about to go all-in on kuuvahki — get your shares here, and invest in a future that belongs only to you!

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: The full name's the "Kuuvahki Concept Investment Certificates" — the hottest product in the speculative market right now!

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: Just fork over 500,000 Mora, and they can be yours! Get in now, and you can ride the blue-ocean wave of profits!

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: Don't hesitate! This is the closest you'll ever be to the wealthiest retirement you can imagine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No thanks, I'm not buying any...

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, you'd better not regret it. Such opportunities to make your dreams come true only come around once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't exactly strike me as someone who's made bank...

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: This... Well this is but a simple periodic adjustment! The market's whims are as the tides, or so they say...

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: But it's exactly at times like these that an overabundance of caution is not the play! Trust me, you'll make your millions back in stocks, just like me!

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: As long as we can get ten more foo— I mean, ten more strategic investors like yourself, we'll be back in the game in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: Are you sure you don't want to think about it some more? This is a great opportunity. If you find the shares suspect, I have some cheaper Snezhnayan bonds at only 300,000 Mora...
